answer: Here is a specific defense: force a unique proof-of-place stamp per epoch that cannot be replayed by siblings. Link analysis on reused seeds marks the whole set. Because it works by requiring post-paid stake that is forfeited on detection, the cluster is rate-limited until independent attestation arrives. The zenith of work and the jetty of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a anchor to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
